name: ai-workspace
description: Zero-dependency Node build of the AI Workspace MVP: BYOK encrypted key vault, SSE streaming chat, PDF/repo RAG with citations, feedback triage, usage and cost tracking.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check make-demo.js && node --check scripts/smoke.js && npm run smoke
scripts.docker:build: docker build --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) -t ai-workspace:local .
